name: The Entropy Catalyst
desc:
The Entropy Catalyst is a location within [Siirka Point](location:siirka_point), an island next to a sea highway and a Luminant gate. It is protected by 2 walls that can be broken through by hitting it or Mantras that break objects.

This location is a Voidzone, meaning that dying here will send you to the Depths. You can find Pristine Lotuses and Erisore here.

By picking up a **knocked** person who has an Oath, and interacting with one of the four holes, it will sacrifice them and a wind will form about the circle, filling with light and prompting the player to sacrifice 2 more.

As this place is a Voidzone, do note that this will send a character to the Depths. When all threeslots are filled, a large glowing orb will emerge from the middle of the pattern. Interacting with this orb will make it explode, knocking back everyone standing nearby. If a player is struck by the explosion, and has met the requirements to become a Linkstrider, they will gain the Oath.

Alternatively, you can pick up Pristine Lotuses here and kill players that have an Oath while you are combat tagged. When 3 of them have been turned into Scarlet Lotuses, return to The Entropy Catalyst and gain the Oath.

Guide on how to get to the Entropy Catalyst: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=K-TZn1VZIcI
additional_info:
-   The music for this area is Of Labours, Veiled by Naktigonis
-   The sacrificial process is similar to one in _Rogue Lineage_.
-   The symbol in the middle of it is the Moonseye put over the Suncross.
    -   It could therefore be inferred that it represents a solar eclipse.
-   While Erisore can be primarily found in [Erisia](location:erisia), it is unknown how it manages to thrive here.
